excerpt: The model of a psychopathological self-schema is depicted in Figure 1 in which habitual negative beliefs about the self (including their personal world and future), become reified through the continuous reinforcement of a feedback loop of affect-biased attention influencing subjective and behavioral symptoms and vice-versa.
overview: This figure-linked statement supplies the review's main causal target: a feedback loop in which negative self-beliefs, attention bias, symptoms, and behavior reinforce one another. It grounds the claim that mindfulness practice is meant to interrupt biased narrative self-processing, while remaining a conceptual model rather than a direct experimental result in this article.
title: Dysfunctional Self-Schema Loop
